newsitem.title: USA: U.S. judge issues order against Sears.
newsitem.headline: U.S. judge issues order against Sears.

text.p: A U.S. District Court judge ordered Sears, Roebuck and Co to halt allegedly "fraudulent" collection activities it took against once-bankrupt debtors, the U.S. Attorney for Massachusetts said late Monday.
The order signed by Judge Joseph Tauro was requested by the U.S. Attorney's office and agreed to by Sears.

As a matter of company policy, Sears misled many of its once-bankrupt credit card holders into believing they had to repay their debts to the company, even though those debts were nullified by a bankruptcy court, court papers alleged.
The U.S. Attorney's office is also seeking restitution for debtors victimized by the practice and civil penalties.
On April 16, the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Boston ordered Sears to stop the practice in Massachusetts.
